user.title: Set up Adaptive Heating
user.description: Select entities from your existing device integrations. Initial mode is Observe and sends no commands. The controller needs a heat pump that behaves like the Gree Versati (circulation pump always on, compressor start at the restart hysteresis, stop 2 °C over the setpoint); on other units use Observe only. It reads the floor slab from the return- and supply-water sensors, keeps it near a target set by the room, the forecast and a learned daily pattern, and starts and stops the compressor itself: it needs the heating-mode entity (the value that means space heating is enabled) and, if your unit exposes it, the restart hysteresis register (read only). Temperature limits and targets below are in °C; selected sensors may use °C or °F. Power inputs may use W or kW. The house constants (loop output per °C, slab estimate share, sensor offsets, restart hysteresis) default to the first house and are not learned: measure them for another house (docs/CONTROLLER.md, Commissioning). Minimum water is the lowest parked and riding setpoint and maximum water caps every write; the lab ranked 25 and 40 °C. Run output 0 kW runs at the unit's minimum output. Battery and grid charge/discharge inputs must be separate positive power measurements. Map the current controller's enabled switch as the inhibit input during migration. Optional disinfection raises the normal tank target and verifies a continuous measured hold. Historical defaults are 68°C target, 65°C for 5 minutes, every 12–16 days; check them for your installation. Disinfection has its own Observe/Automatic mode and starts in Observe. Restoring an interrupted tank target can still run in Observe or Off. AC assistance is optional help: it has its own Observe mode, needs both main and AC Automatic to command, borrows only an AC that is Off, and is asked for only while the floor is already heating and the room is clearly under its target. Verify its outdoor operating limit. A configured AC power meter enables a session energy budget; without one only the runtime limit applies. An interrupted owned AC may be restored to Off even in Observe/Off.

data.minimum_water: Minimum water setpoint while idle or running (°C)
data.comfort_band: Room comfort tolerance for scheduling tank disinfection (°C)
data.stale_minutes: Maximum age of outdoor and power readings (minutes)
data.solar_preheat: Allow limited preheating from sustained solar surplus
data.battery_ready_soc: Battery percentage required for optional preheating
data.preheat_degrees: Maximum extra room target for preheating (°C)
data.tank_target_entity: Normal hot-water tank target number (optional, separate from heating)
data.disinfection_hold_minutes: Continuous time at or above threshold (minutes)
data.disinfection_sample_minutes: Maximum tank reading age, or heat-pump outage during a cycle (minutes)
data.ac_entity: AC climate entity for optional assistance
data.ac_room_entity: External temperature sensor in the AC room
data.ac_power_entity: AC electrical power meter (optional; enables measured session budget)
data.ac_min_outdoor: Lowest outdoor temperature permitted for AC assistance (°C; verify equipment)
data.ac_preheat_max: Maximum room temperature for AC assistance (°C)
data.ac_min_on_minutes: Minimum AC run (minutes; stops sooner for temperature/operating limits)
data.ac_min_off_minutes: Minimum AC rest before another session (minutes)
data.ac_settle_minutes: Exclude AC effects from learning after stopping (minutes)
data.ac_max_session_kwh: AC session electricity budget when a meter is mapped (kWh)
data.ac_sample_seconds: Maximum AC sensor age and meter sampling gap (seconds)
data.heating_mode_entity: Heating-mode entity (needed for Automatic: confirms space heating is enabled while the compressor is idle)
data.heating_mode_state: Value that enables space heating (for example heat or 4)
data.heating_idle_state: Compressor-idle activity while heating remains enabled (for example OFF)
data.restart_hysteresis_entity: Heat-pump restart hysteresis register (optional, read only)
data.restart_hysteresis: Restart hysteresis when no register is mapped (K)
data.run_output_kw: Heat output while running (kW; 0 = the unit's minimum)
data.loop_kw_per_celsius: Loop heat per °C of supply-return difference (kW/°C)
data.slab_supply_share: Supply-water share in the running floor estimate (0–0.6)
data.control_sensor_offset: Unit control sensor minus return/supply water (°C)
data.outlet_sensor_offset: True supply minus the supply-water sensor (°C)
data.ac_assist_below: Ask for AC help when the room is this far under target while the floor heats (°C)

error.invalid_limits: Check the temperature limits, the slab controller's house constants and the restart hysteresis. Extra preheating must fit within the comfort tolerance.
error.entity_missing: Select an existing entity of the required type.
error.already_controlled: Another Adaptive Heating entry already controls this setpoint.
error.state_required: Enter the exact state that means space heating (for example HEAT or on).
error.temperature_required: This entity must have a °C or °F temperature unit.
error.battery_incomplete: Select all three battery measurements, or leave all three empty.
error.solar_incomplete: Solar preheating needs measured PV, grid import, and grid export power.
error.invalid_disinfection_limits: Check disinfection temperatures, hold duration, sample age, scheduling window and timeout.
error.tank_incomplete: Select both the measured tank temperature and its normal tank target, or leave both empty.
error.separate_tank_target: Use the normal hot-water tank target, not the space-heating target.
error.invalid_tank_target: The tank number must be available, use °C or °F, and support the configured target within its minimum, maximum and step.
error.disinfection_active: Cancel disinfection and wait for normal tank target restoration before changing settings.
error.invalid_ac_limits: Check the AC outdoor limit, ceiling, assistance threshold, minimum/maximum run, rest time, sensor age and session electricity budget.
error.ac_active: Select AC assistance Off and wait for confirmed restoration before changing settings.
error.ac_incomplete: Select both an AC climate entity and an external room thermometer, or leave all AC mappings empty.
error.ac_heat_required: The AC must support explicit Heat and Off modes.
error.idle_hot_water_conflict: The compressor-idle state must differ from the hot-water state.
